ficha_publicada.complicacoes: The Hero Rebuilt: Victor Stone’s body has been rebuilt nearly from scratch several times, and echoes of those traumas still haunt him. Insecurity: Particularly when it comes to his relationships, Cyborg is quietly unsure if others see him as a man or as a machine. Man and Machine: While his human side is a part of Victor’s strength, it is also an element of his construction that is occasionally vulnerable. POWERS & ABILITIES As Cyborg, Victor Stone’s mind is augmented by an onboard computer, his strength is mechanically amplified, and his body can power tools and weapons like the sonic disruptor attached to his arm. Bonding with the alien Omegadrome also gave him the ability to speak to computers and other electronics.
